cohort: Singletons from the NINFEA birth cohort with available anthropometric measurements at the age of 4 (3151 born with vaginal and 1111 born with caesarean delivery)
finding: Maternal vaginal infections in the third trimester of pregnancy were associated with a higher risk of overweight/obesity at age 4 in children delivered vaginally, especially among children of mothers with pre-pregnancy overweight/obesity.
mod_finding: The association between vaginal infections and overweight/obesity at age 4 was only present in children born by vaginal delivery.
